motions.title: Wire the heartbeat auto-dispatch loop into the runtime (the kanban 'auto process')
motions.description: The kanban board (host_council_server/src/kanban_handlers.rs) is fully wired -- GET board/stats/verify + POST cards + POST move, all reading/writing kanban_state.json atomically -- yet it is frozen at 645 cards (640 DONE / 5 REVIEW / 0 IN_PROGRESS / 0 TODO / 0 active) because NO loop auto-creates or advances cards. The heartbeat scheduler (trm_uefi_kernel/src/heartbeat_scheduler.rs) is ported but has no runtime caller (the 'a port with no caller is +0 bytes' trap). HEARTBEAT.md holds 1 pending '- [ ]' task waiting to be dispatched. Fix wired: a background thread in host_council_server polls HEARTBEAT.md every 60s, auto-assigns each pending task via the domain ontology (auto_assign_agent) and creates a kanban card, then marks the item '- [x]'. This is the honest 'auto process' -- the scheduler turns pending work into cards; it does NOT fabricate DONE (cards advance only when an agent actually works them). cargo check passes (91 pre-existing warnings, 0 new).
